_comment: THE LIFEGAIN BREAKPOINT (AccomplishedAlchemist chunk C2a, 2026-10-18): cast Nourish, tap Accomplished
Alchemist for 6, spend it -- in ONE main phase.
Turn 4: four Forests + the turn's drawn-and-played Forest + an Accomplished Alchemist (not sick, no life
gained yet). Hand: Nourish ({G}{G}, gain 6) and Stroke of Genius. Opponent library: 6, so the kill is
Stroke at the opponent with X = 6 = {6}{2}{U} = 9 mana. The plan-START pool is 5 Forests + the Alchemist
credited 1 = 6 mana: Stroke alone reaches X = 3, and Nourish + Stroke no more. Only the RE-PLAN after
Nourish resolves sees the Alchemist worth 6: 3 Forests + 6 (blue) = 9 = X 6. That re-plan is site 9's
LIFEGAIN route (CollectActivationKeys' kActLifeYield key + PlanOpensBreakpoint's lifegain clause); before
chunk C2a the line was unreachable at any depth or budget and the win was turn 5.
No other clock: opponent life 20, nothing deals damage that could kill by turn 4.
